- Whether Redwood will invoice net under reverse-charge for our EU business-to-business relationship (we are UK-registered, VAT GB9999999).

Subject: Re: Initiating direct debit + VAT reconciliation for August settlement

Hi Sofia — thanks for the PDF, and good to hear you're switching to direct debit. Quick summary and next steps from our side: 

1) VAT / reverse-charge: For EU/UK B2B customers we generally apply the reverse-charge (i.e., issue a net invoice) when the buyer provides a valid VAT number and residency evidence. For the UK GB VAT number you provided, we need: 
   - the VAT registration number (as on your certificate)
   - confirmation of legal entity that matches our billing record
   - a recent invoice or registration extract if there's any naming discrepancy

If validation passes, we'll mark the customer as VAT-validated in our billing system and future monthly platform fees will be invoiced net (reverse-charge). If not validated, the invoice will include VAT or we may need to withhold, depending on local rules.

2) Direct debit: We can accept SEPA or UK BACS for LedgerWorks. To enable it we require: 
   - signed DD mandate (I've attached the sample dd-mandate-sample.pdf).
   - bank account details + sort code/IBAN and the account holder name (must match the legal entity).
   - authorization email from an AP contact (so we have a paper trail).

Operational timeline: once we have completed validation and the signed mandate, we typically take 5 business days to provision direct debit and one additional settlement cycle to confirm the first pull. If you can return the signed mandate today, we will prioritise provisioning for the 31-Aug run but cannot guarantee the pull if validation completes after the cut-off.

I've attached a draft settlement invoice for August (settlement-invoice-202608.pdf) for your bookkeeping — it is still pending VAT validation. Marissa, can you confirm whether Finance is OK to release the final payment schedule to AP once Sofía provides the signed mandate and confirmation of the entity name?

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
attachments: settlement-invoice-202608.pdf, dd-mandate-sample.pdf
